The '''Telos Polar Irrigation System''' was the hub at the primary source of fresh water on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Telos IV]]. Much like the one that was part of the capital of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], it extended to nearly every city on Telos. In the aftermath of the [[Bombing of Telos IV]] that was carried out by the traitorous [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]] in the opening stages of the [[Jedi Civil War]], the irrigation system was abandoned, leaving its hub, nestled into the snow-covered mountains at the northern latitudes of the planet, empty.

==History==
Some time after the [[Conclave at Katarr|Conclave on Katarr]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Atris]] rediscovered the irrigation system. After moving a large collection of [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]] that she had gathered over the years as well as many Jedi artifacts that had been removed from the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] prior to its [[Attack on Dantooine (Jedi Civil War)|destruction]], Atris used the abandoned facility in an attempt to rebuild the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. As part of her plans, she brought the [[Handmaiden Sisters]], including [[Brianna]], to Telos, intending to use them as "watchers" for the Order that she planned to rebuild. Due to the irrigation system's secluded location and the echoes within [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that had been generated by the scourging of Telos, this proved an ideal hiding place from the [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] led by [[Darth Sion]] and [[Darth Nihilus]].

In [[3951 BBY]] the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] visited the irrigation system's hub, now the [[Telosian Jedi Academy]], to finally collect her famed [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]''.
